title: When Simultaneous Switching Underestimates RC-Grid Droop: A Validated EM-IR Audit
description: Validated and reproducible two-node RC counterexample to an unconditional simultaneous-switching upper-bound assertion in a pinned open-source EDA analyzer. Includes mathematical derivation, native Rust test evidence, ngspice comparisons, exact free-phase optimum and a proposed upstream documentation/regression patch. This is not a new general sign-off algorithm or a claim of silicon failure. AI-assisted analysis and code are disclosed in the report.
